dialogues.speaker: Mahshid
dialogues.text: Next time someone wants to trade shifts with you, don't agree to it!

dialogues.speaker: Mahshid
dialogues.text: You Eremites are too used to idling in the desert to know the importance of rules!

dialogues.speaker: Mahshid
dialogues.text: If everyone switched shifts at will and didn't follow schedule, it would turn into a big mess!

dialogues.speaker: Mahshid
dialogues.text: Even though you're a mercenary hired by the Akademiya, your job of keeping law and order on the docks is as crucial as the researchers', got it?
